Angle.description: An angle in degrees: a number, to at most 9 decimals (nanodegrees). An exponent is read exactly; Silico writes plain decimals. (Strings are reserved for expressions, which aren't read yet.)

Camera.description:
A camera: where it looks from and at, which way is up in the image, and how much it
sees. The document is Z-up. A result's camera can be passed back unchanged.

eye.description:
The eye, in global coordinates (mm), within 1e12 mm of the origin, at least a
nanometre from the target. An orthographic view uses only its direction from the
target; a perspective eye mustn't be inside a body or on its surface.

field_of_view.description:
A perspective camera's vertical angle, in degrees, its range by the image's size: see
the error; null for an orthographic camera.

target.description: What the view is centred on, in global coordinates (mm).

up.description:
Which way is up in the image: any vector with a part across the view, made
perpendicular to the view and of unit length in a result.

view_height.description:
An orthographic camera's view's height, in mm, up to 1e12, its least by the image's
size: see the error; null for a perspective camera.

Length.description: A length in millimetres: a number, to at most 6 decimals (nanometres). An exponent is read exactly; Silico writes plain decimals. (Strings are reserved for expressions, which aren't read yet.)

ModelChoice.description: Which model to read: the current one, or the newest published.

oneOf.description:
The session's current revision's model, rebuilt if it isn't yet: what an agent that
just edited reads.

The newest model published, which may be an older revision's, read at once: what a
UI reads while a rebuild runs.

NamedView.description:
A named view, as Fusion's ViewCube names them, the document Z-up: `front` looks from
−Y, `right` from +X, `top` from +Z, and the corners and edges combine them.

Projection.description:
How a camera projects: from the eye in parallel (`orthographic`, as every named view
is), or from the eye as a point (`perspective`).

request.description:
`render`'s request: a PNG of the model's bodies from a named view or a camera (one,
the other null), with elements highlighted, and where to write it.

camera.description: A camera; null with a named view.

highlight.description:
The names of faces and edges to highlight in Fusion's selection blue, as `elements`
names them: at most 1,000.

replace.description: Whether to replace a file already at `to`.

session.description: The session's ID, as `open` gave it.

to.description:
Where to write the PNG: a `.png` path in the workspace, never a document or its
cache; or null.

view.description: A named view, fitted to the bodies; null with a camera.

request.title: RenderRequest

result.description:
`render`'s result. The PNG itself is never in it: it's the reply's image over MCP, or a
Rust client's to show.

camera.description:
The camera it was taken with: the one given, or the named view's, its up made
perpendicular to the view and of unit length.

path.description: Where the PNG was written, as the request gave it; null if `to` was.

png_bytes.description:
The PNG's size, in bytes. It depends on the machine (its renderer), so it isn't a
result to compare.

result.title: RenderResult
